summary: @onereach/postcss-scoped-selector ships preinstall alternate-runtime dropper that executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package advertises itself as a small PostCSS selector-scoping plugin (index.js is a 47-line wrapper around postcss-selector-parser), but its package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases for the installer's platform and architecture, unzips it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes the downloaded Bun binary against a bundled math_init.js file with stdio inherited. math_init.js is a single-line 727,680-byte payload with heavy obfuscation — string-array rotation, a decoder function, and mangled identifiers — bearing no relation to CSS selector processing. The dropped alternate runtime is used specifically to execute this opaque bundle, bypassing Node-based scanners at npm install time. The advertised PostCSS functionality is unrelated to the shipped payload and dropper, consistent with a hijack or squat of the @onereach scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
